title: Joint Spatiotemporal Spectral Neural Operators for Learning PDEs on Irregular Domains
abstract: arXiv:2608.29892v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning solution operators for partial differential equations (PDEs) on irregular and geometry-dependent domains remains a central challenge in scientific machine learning. While spectral methods provide strong inductive biases for modeling global interactions, they are typically limited to regular domains, and existing neural approaches often require domain warping, interpolation, or costly geometric embeddings. We introduce the \textbf{Graph Spectral Neural Operator (GSNO)}, a neural operator that combines spatial graph spectral decompositions with temporal Fourier transforms through a unified space--time spectral kernel. This formulation enables globally coherent operator learning on non-Cartesian discretizations without domain warping or autoregressive rollouts. By replacing learned geometric embeddings with a graph Laplacian spectral basis, GSNO provides geometry-aware spectral learning with low parameter complexity. Across steady

translated_title: 面向不规则域上偏微分方程学习的联合时空谱神经算子
translated_abstract: 在不规则且依赖几何形状的域上学习偏微分方程（PDE）的解算子仍然是科学机器学习中的核心挑战。虽然谱方法为建模全局交互提供了强大的归纳偏置，但它们通常仅限于规则域，且现有的神经方法往往需要域扭曲、插值或代价高昂的几何嵌入。我们提出了图谱神经算子（GSNO），这是一种通过统一的时空谱核将空间图谱分解与时间傅里叶变换相结合的神经算子。这一设计使得在非笛卡尔离散化网格上无需域扭曲或自回归展开即可实现全局一致的算子学习。通过用图拉普拉斯谱基替代学习得到的几何嵌入，GSNO 以较低的参数复杂度实现了几何感知的谱学习。在稳态……
tldr: 提出图谱神经算子（GSNO），通过统一的时空谱核融合空间图谱分解与时间傅里叶变换，无需域扭曲或自回归展开即可在不规则域上实现几何感知、低参数复杂度的偏微分方程算子学习。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Graph Spectral Neural Operator (GSNO), which unifies spatial graph spectral decomposition and temporal Fourier transforms in a single space-time spectral kernel, enabling geometry-aware, low-parameter-complexity PDE operator learning on irregular domains without domain warping or autoregressive rollouts.
